_comment: Regression baseline capturing the CURRENT website behaviour at commit f7ca348, so any future change that alters the existing models fails loudly. Generated from R/*.R with the default-ish parameter set below; the JavaScript in web/index.html was verified numerically equivalent to these values (max|Δ| < 5e-11 for release, < 5e-5 abs for tissue). Do not edit by hand — regenerate with tests/regression/capture_baseline.R only when an intentional model change is being recorded.
